risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~165% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.115), which favours a robust combination.

attempts.rationale: Test a robust median combination on pool3 to see if median outperforms trimmed_mean on the same pool.
Test a best_single strategy with the highly ranked CWT_catboost to see if a single top model outperforms the robust combinations.
Test a robust median combination on the smaller, more stable pool1 to see if it beats the current trimmed_mean pool3 leader.
Test a dba weighting on the full pool3 to see if it improves over trimmed_mean and median.
Test a robust median combination on pool2, which includes a slightly larger set of correlated models but may improve stability.
Test a trimmed‑mean over the full model set to see if expanding the pool improves robustness.
Test dba on pool1 to see if it improves over current leader for 50/50 criterion.
Try a dba strategy on pool2 to see if it improves over the trimmed_mean baseline.
Test a weighted combination using inverse error weights on the robust pool3 to see if a data‑driven weighting beats trimmed‑mean.
Test weighted combination using handle w1 on pool3 to see if different weighting improves over w2 on pool4.
Test a weighted combination on pool4 using handle w1 to see if different weighting improves over current leader.
Evaluate a simple mean over pool4 to see if it improves on the weighted w2 leader.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.0038. Series context: trend strength 0.8376 and seasonal strength 0.1261; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.115); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.347.
